name: jenkins
description: Jenkins CI: job status, build log tails, and triggering builds.

settings.name: JENKINS_TOKEN
settings.label: API token
settings.help: Jenkins → your user → Security → API Token → Add new token

guidance: Jobs are named by their path, with folders: e.g. `team/app/main` for a multibranch branch job.
After pushing, check the job's status; when a build failed, read the log tail before changing code.
Triggering a build is a write and needs the user's approval.

functions.name: whoami
functions.description: Check the connection: the user the token belongs to.

functions.name: job_status
functions.description: A job's last build: number, result (SUCCESS, FAILURE, …) or still running, when, how long, and its URL.

functions.name: build_log_tail
functions.description: The last lines of a build's console log (default: the last build).

functions.name: trigger_build
functions.description: Start a build of a job, with optional parameters.
